questions.stem: Rakesh, a 40-year-old man with a long history of bipolar disorder, had been stable on a maintenance lithium treatment for the past year. Which of the following best describes a current working hypothesis about lithium's molecular mechanism of action of lithium ?

options.label: C
options.text: Increased serotonin reuptake into serotonergic terminals

options.label: D
options.text: Decreased synthesis of inositol triphosphate (IP3) and diacylglycerol (DAG)

questions.answerText: Decreased synthesis of inositol triphosphate (IP3) and diacylglycerol (DAG)
questions.solutionHtml:
Decreased synthesis of inositol triphosphate (IP3) and diacylglycerol (DAG)

Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 474-77

questions.stem: A 32-year-old man was admitted to a psychiatric hospital during an acute manic attack. The man had his first manic attack at 27 and three other manic attacks since then. A diagnosis of acute mania was made, and therapy was prescribed, including a drug blocking D2 and 5-HT2 receptors in the brain. Which of the following drugs was most likely prescribed?
questions.solutionHtml:
Olanzapine

Olanzapine is used in the treatment of schizophrenia (a mental disorder that can result in hallucinations or delusions and also adversely affects a person’s ability to think and behave) and mania.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 470-471

questions.stem: A 30-year-old woman who has bipolar disorder has been maintained successfully on lithium therapy. Now she planned to become pregnant. Her psychiatrist decided to stop lithium and start another medication. Which of the following drugs would be appropriate for this patient?
questions.solutionHtml:
Quetiapine

Quetiapine is a prescription medicine used to treat schizophrenia and mania. It is also used to treat bipolar disorders. It modulates the action of certain chemical messengers in the brain that affect thoughts.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 473-474

questions.stem: A 40-year-old woman recently diagnosed with major depressive disorder had started therapy with sertraline. However, one month later, her condition had not changed appreciably, and her psychiatrist decided to add a second medication (augmentation therapy). He prescribed a drug with multiple mechanisms of action, including inhibition of glycogen synthase kinase 3. Which of the following drugs was most likely prescribed?
questions.solutionHtml:
Lithium

Lithium is used to treat mania which is part of bipolar disorder (manic-depressive illness). It is also used daily to reduce the frequency and severity of manic episodes.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 474-477

questions.stem: A 45-year-old woman Kanchan came to OPD complaining of a hand tremor and an increasing need to urinate. The woman, recently diagnosed with a psychiatric disorder, had been taking a psychotropic drug for three weeks. Physical examination disclosed cystic acne with folliculitis over the trunk and thorax. Which drugs most likely caused the patient's symptoms and signs?
questions.solutionHtml:
Lithium

Lithium is used to treat mania which is part of bipolar disorder (manic-depressive illness). It is also used daily to reduce the frequency and severity of manic episodes.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 474-477

questions.stem: A 49-year-old man with manic depression has been on lithium for long-term therapy. However, because of the worsening symptoms, he is placed on Ziprasidone. The patient must be warned about which of the following adverse effects?
questions.solutionHtml:
Asthenia

Ziprasidone is a serotonin and dopamine antagonist used to manage bipolar disorder. It can be used alone or in combination with lithium. Significant side effects to be aware of include asthenia.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 469-470
